status: Terminal-version planning inventory; saved Rev E schematic, PCB, BOM and library are unchanged.
count_basis: PCB connector bodies, excluding cable housings/crimp contacts, buttons, LEDs, test points and power-board terminals.
signal_family: XUNPU GH1.25 side-entry SMT accepted for planning. ADC2P and PWM8P board-header recommendations accepted; exact other pin-count models, footprints and mating views remain to be checked.

connector_groups.name: PWM
connector_groups.status: Confirmed quantity/8P; see separate logical pin-order proposal.

connector_groups.name: ADC
connector_groups.status: Confirmed quantity; 2P recommendation accepted, physical pin order pending.

connector_groups.name: SPI
connector_groups.status: Two buses confirmed; retain saved 6P roles. Supply voltage/load/protection pending sensor selection.

connector_groups.name: I2C
connector_groups.status: Two independent buses confirmed; 4P structure proposed.

connector_groups.name: ABZ
connector_groups.status: Two ports confirmed; retain saved 5P roles. Supply voltage/load/protection pending sensor selection.

connector_groups.name: CAN
connector_groups.status: One port confirmed; retain saved 3P roles. Requires transceiver on controller; existing PHY is classic CAN.

connector_groups.name: TTL_UART
connector_groups.status: One port confirmed; retain saved 3P form, 3.3V logic, no added supply pin.

connector_groups.name: SWD
connector_groups.status: Retain one debug interface and saved 5P roles; VTREF is reference detection, not a supply inlet.

connector_groups.name: CTRL
connector_groups.status: Proposed two 6P control/protection ports; BRAKE_B is only a pin reserve, not an implemented second brake power stage.

connector_groups.name: 5V_IN
connector_groups.status: Proposed regulated-5V inlet; exact connector TBD, preferably a visibly different mating geometry from ADC2P. Not a raw 12-24V input.

contact_note: Repeated GND, power and shared CTRL_READY contacts are included; 91 contacts are not 91 MCU GPIOs. MCU allocation remains 62 planned plus one optional brake pin.
GPIO_expansion_status: The 23 unallocated MCU pads currently have no dedicated expansion connector in this terminal inventory. Any later GPIO expansion connector must be added explicitly and changes the total.
scope_notes: BRAKE is included in CTRL, so no additional brake signal port is counted.
Brake-resistor power, DC bus and U/V/W terminals are on inverter, not controller.
The saved inverter optional sensor-5V output J7 has not been requested on controller; it is not added.
RESET/BOOT buttons and five onboard LEDs are not connectors; no USB or LLC connector is added.
SPI/ABZ supply PWR remains selectable by sensor design. Saved board routes optional/default-DNP zero-ohm links toward +5V_SENSOR; this is not a new 3.3V supply choice or permission for 5V logic.
I2C uses 3.3V pullups. External sensor supply load/protection and sequencing still need design.
Signal lists are contact roles, not finalized physical pin order; mating-view harness drawings remain necessary.
Controller input is regulated 5V from a power board or one suitable source. Do not parallel independent 5V supplies.
